SKSM.JIGYOSHOCD, JGSM.JIGYOSHONM,
NMST.NYKNDD NYKNDD, NMST.SKYSAKICD SKYSAKICD,
(SELECT TNSM.TNSHAMEI FROM S02M003T TNSM WHERE TNSM.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TNSM.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TNSM.TNSHACD = NMST.KAISHUTNSHACD ) TNSHAMEI,
NMST.DNPYNO DNPYNO, SUM(NMST.NYKNKIN) NYKNKIN, SUM(NMST.NEBIKIKIN) NEBIKIKIN, SUM(NMST.TESURYO) TESURYO, MAX(NMST.BIKO) BIKO, SKSM.SKYSAKINMN1 SKYSAKINMN1, SYKM.MOJISETTEIATAI MOJISETTEIATAI, NMST.NYKNKIND NYKNKIND, SYPM.SHOPNM SHOPNM FROM S10T001T NMST, S02M017T SKSM, S02M047T JGSM, S02M006T SYKM, S02M046T SYPM WHERE NMST.APKIHONCD = SKSM.APKIHONCD(+) AND NMST.SHOPCD = SKSM.SHOPCD(+) AND NMST.SKYSAKICD = SKSM.SKYSAKICD(+) AND SKSM.APKIHONCD = JGSM.APKIHONCD(+) AND SKSM.SHOPCD = JGSM.SHOPCD(+) AND SKSM.JIGYOSHOCD = JGSM.JIGYOSHOCD(+) AND SYKM.APKIHONCD (+)= '000' AND SYKM.SHOPCD (+)= '000' AND SYKM.SETTEINO (+)= '050' AND SYKM.RCRDKBN (+)= 'M' AND SYKM.SETTEICD (+)= NMST.NYKNKIND AND NMST.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NMST.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NMST.YUKOKBN = '1' AND SYPM.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SYPM.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

#{kinshu}

SELECT SUM(NYKNKIN) AS NYKNKIN FROM ( SELECT NMST.NYKNDD AS DD , NULL AS SHNCD , '00000000' AS SHNNMKIRIKAEDD , SYKM3.MOJISETTEIATAI AS GENZSHNNM , SYKM3.MOJISETTEIATAI AS SHINSHNNM , NULL AS KEIJOKBN , NULL AS SURYO , NULL AS URITANI , NULL AS UNT , NULL AS URIKIN , NULL AS SHOHITAX , NULL AS TAXKIN , (NMST.NYKNKIN + NMST.NEBIKIKIN + NMST.TESURYO) AS NYKNKIN , NMST.BIKO AS BIKO , NMST.DNPYNO AS DNPYNO , NMST.TOKUISAKICD , TKSM2.TOKUISAKINMN1 AS TOKUISAKINM , NULL AS URIDNPYMEISAINO , NMST.INPTSYSTMYMD AS TOUROKUDD , NMST.INPTSYSTMJIKAN AS TOUROKUJIKAN , NMST.TOSHAAPKIHONCD AS TOUROKUAP , NMST.TOSHASHOPCD AS TOUROKUSHOP , NMST.TOSHACD AS TOUROKUSHACD , TTSM.TNSHAMEI AS TNSHAMEI , NULL AS EDANO FROM S10T001T NMST LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM3 ON NMST.NYKNKIND = SYKM3.SETTEICD AND SYKM3.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM3.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM3.SETTEINO = '050' AND SYKM3.RCRDKBN = '1' LEFT JOIN S02M003T TTSM ON NMST.TOSHAAPKIHONCD = TTSM.APKIHONCD AND NMST.TOSHASHOPCD = TTSM.SHOPCD AND NMST.TOSHACD = TTSM.TNSHACD LEFT JOIN S02M013T TKSM2 ON NMST.APKIHONCD = TKSM2.APKIHONCD AND NMST.SHOPCD = TKSM2.SHOPCD AND NMST.TOKUISAKICD = TKSM2.TOKUISAKICD WHERE NMST.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NMST.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NMST.SKYSAKICD = #{skysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NMST.SKYPRCSJISSIDD = '00000000' AND NMST.YUKOKBN = '1' )

SELECT TO_NUMBER(MIN(LPAD(NYKNKIND, 2, '0'))) NYKNKIND, NVL(SUM(NYKNKIN * - 1), 0) NYKNKIN, NVL(SUM(NEBIKIKIN * - 1), 0) NEBIKIKIN, NVL(SUM(TESURYO * - 1), 0) TESURYO, MAX(NYKNDD) NYKNDD, MAX(SKYSHOOTPTARINASHIKBN) SKYSHOOTPTARINASHIKBN, MAX(BIKO) BIKO, ( SELECT URICHOSEIKIN * (- 1) FROM S10T003T WHERE S10T003T.APKIHONCD = S10T001T.APKIHONCD AND S10T003T.SHOPCD = S10T001T.SHOPCD AND S10T003T.NYKNDNPYNO = S10T001T.DNPYNO ) AS URICHOSEIKIN, MAX(S10T001T.KAISHUTNSHACD) AS KAISHUTNSHACD, MIN(S10T001T.YUKOKBN) AS YUKOKBN, MIN(S10T001T.INPTSYSTMYMD) AS INPTSYSTMYMD, MIN(S10T001T.INPTSYSTMJIKAN) AS INPTSYSTMJIKAN, MIN(S10T001T.TOSHAAPKIHONCD) AS TOSHAAPKIHONCD, MIN(S10T001T.TOSHASHOPCD) AS TOSHASHOPCD, MIN(S10T001T.TOSHACD) AS TOSHACD, MIN(TTSM.TNSHAMEI) AS TNSHAMEI, MIN(SYKM.MOJISETTEIATAI) AS NYKNKINDNM FROM S10T001T LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT APKIHONCD AS T_APKIHONCD, SHOPCD AS T_SHOPCD, TNSHACD, TNSHAMEI FROM S02M003T ) TTSM ON S10T001T.TOSHAAPKIHONCD = TTSM.T_APKIHONCD AND S10T001T.TOSHASHOPCD = TTSM.T_SHOPCD AND S10T001T.TOSHACD = TTSM.TNSHACD LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM ON ( SYKM.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM.SETTEINO = '050' AND SYKM.SETTEICD = S10T001T.NYKNKIND ) LEFT JOIN S01M004T CNDT ON ( CNDT.CONDITIONID = 'CN001' AND CNDT.SETTEIATAI = '1' ) WHERE S10T001T.APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S10T001T.SHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S10T001T.SKYSAKICD = #{skysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S10T001T.DNPYNO = #{nykndnpyno,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND S10T001T.KAIREKINKBN = '0' AND S10T001T.YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY S10T001T.APKIHONCD, S10T001T.SHOPCD, S10T001T.DNPYNO

SELECT TO_NUMBER(LPAD(NYKK.NYKNKIND, 2, '0')) AS NYKNKIND , NYKK.NYKNKIN , NYKK.NEBIKIKIN , NYKK.TESURYO , NYKK.NYKNDD , NYKN.BIKO , NYKN.KAISHUTNSHACD , NYKK.URICHOSEIKIN , TNTM.TNSHAMEI FROM S10T003T NYKK INNER JOIN ( SELECT APKIHONCD , SHOPCD , SKYSAKICD , DNPYNO , MAX(BIKO) AS BIKO , MAX(KAISHUTNSHACD) AS KAISHUTNSHACD FROM S10T001T WHERE APKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SHOPCD = #{shopcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SKYSAKICD = #{skysakicd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DNPYNO = #{dnpyno, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND YUKOKBN = '1' GROUP BY APKIHONCD , SHOPCD , SKYSAKICD , DNPYNO ) NYKN ON NYKN.APKIHONCD = NYKK.APKIHONCD AND NYKN.SHOPCD = NYKK.SHOPCD AND NYKN.SKYSAKICD = NYKK.SKYSAKICD AND NYKN.DNPYNO = NYKK.NYKNDNPYNO INNER JOIN S02M003T TNTM ON TNTM.APKIHONCD = NYKN.APKIHONCD AND TNTM.SHOPCD = NYKN.SHOPCD AND TNTM.TNSHACD = NYKN.KAISHUTNSHACD
